# openpreflight docs

> A small CI provider for private repositories. One Go binary and one SQLite file: register a GitHub App, add your repositories, and get one Check Run for each commit.

This is the how-to site. The marketing site has the product positioning.
The pages use ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English; the glossary gives one term for each concept.

Docs: https://docs.openpreflight.xyz
Marketing: https://openpreflight.xyz
Source: https://github.com/openpreflight/openpreflight
Release: https://github.com/openpreflight/openpreflight/releases/tag/v2.3.1 (v2.3.1, 27 September 2026)
License: Apache-2.0

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/getting-started/overview/): What openpreflight does, and its limits
- [Quickstart](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/getting-started/quickstart/): From an empty host to the first Check Run
- [Comparison](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/getting-started/comparison/): Woodpecker, Drone, actions/runner, Jenkins

## Deploy

- [Deployment](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/deploy/deployment/): Compose, volumes, Docker engine access
- [Networking](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/deploy/networking/): Public HTTPS for the webhook, live logs through a proxy
- [Coolify](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/deploy/coolify/): Optional repository picker and deployment target

## Configure

- [Register a GitHub App](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/configure/github-app/): Permissions, events, webhook URL, GitHub Enterprise Server
- [Add repositories](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/configure/bindings/): The bindings table is the allow-list
- [Pipelines](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/configure/pipelines/): The `.ci.yml` file and the runtime
- [Path filters](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/configure/path-filters/): Pattern syntax, fail-open, monorepos
- [Dry run](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/configure/dry-run/): What a commit will run, and which layer supplied it
- [Fork pull requests](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/configure/fork-pull-requests/): Opt-in checks for forks, in a container

## Use

- [Runs](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/use/runs/): The run page, skip reasons, cancel and re-run
- [Logs](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/use/logs/): Full logs, live tail, shareable logs

## Operate

- [Health](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/operate/health/): The health endpoint and status
- [Backup and restore](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/operate/backup-restore/): ci.db and the logs
- [Upgrade](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/operate/upgrade/): Upgrade, restart, schema migrations, release policy
- [Rotate the secret key](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/operate/rotate-secret-key/): Replace CI_SECRET_KEY
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/operate/troubleshooting/): Symptom, cause and fix

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/configuration/): Environment, settings, binding fields, pipeline keys
- [How configuration resolves](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/resolution/): The five layers and the inferred defaults
- [API](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/api/): JSON API routes
- [Architecture](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/architecture/): One process, and what is absent
- [Security model](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/security-model/): HMAC, encryption, trust boundaries, sessions
- [Glossary](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/glossary/): One term for each concept
- [ADR 001](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/decisions/001-database/): SQLite in-process
- [ADR 002](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/decisions/002-authentication/): Local admin, opaque sessions
- [ADR 003](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/decisions/003-github-app/): Our GitHub App, not Coolify's connector
- [ADR 004](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/decisions/004-docker-executor/): Optional docker run executor
- [ADR 005](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/decisions/005-check-suite-gating/): Gate on the check suite
- [ADR 006](https://docs.openpreflight.xyz/reference/decisions/006-job-ids/): Job ids without a UUID dependency
